source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per OpenCode's documentation (opencode.ai/docs/cli, /docs/permissions, retrieved 2026-10-13) as recorded in TDD 4.6, and the 2026-10-14 live checks (docs/research/live-checks-2026-10-14-opencode.md, opencode v2.0.23)
notes: Added by T4.52 (2026-10-14, Delegated agent work, not owner-approved). The range admits no version (ADR-0009, ROADMAP 6.8 conventions): the adapter fails the version gate with ADAPTER_VERSION_UNVERIFIED until `switchboard adapters validate opencode` passes a version, so nothing here is a claim that any OpenCode version is validated; the documentation describes v1 and the installed CLI was v2.0.23, a different major. Automation surface: `opencode run --format json --standalone -- <prompt>`, one process per run (TDD 4.6 transport decision); `--standalone` keeps the run's tools in a private server inside the run's process group instead of the host's shared background service; `opencode --version` for the version. Flags cited by TDD 4.6 source [D-cli] and observed in `run --help` in the 2026-10-14 live check: --format (default, json), --standalone, --session; `--` before the prompt is an Assumption. Never emitted: --auto (bypass-class, Q-83), --continue, --fork, --server, --share, --model, --agent, --file; OPENCODE_PERMISSION, OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT, OPENCODE_CONFIG, the XDG directories and provider keys stay out of the environment (ADR-0003); OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1 is set (its effect was not exercised). The argv audit refuses --auto outside an approved privileged bypass run (registry entry; ADR-0035). Compile matrix (Delegated, fail closed, Q-64 and Q-83): inspect-untrusted, edit-untrusted, test-sandboxed and trusted-development are Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED): no per-run deny took effect on v2.0.23, the default ran shell commands including git commit and git push, no sandbox is documented, and the repository's opencode.json and AGENTS.md load. privileged compiles only for an approved scope with bypass true, worktree files, shell broad, network on, repository_config enabled and no requested model, with no bypass flag: OpenCode confines nothing in that run; the controller's worktree, the tool-call guard (ADR-0039), FR-GIT-03 and FR-GIT-06 remain. Auth (T4.54): UNKNOWN until implemented; `opencode auth list` exits 0 in every state and `auth export` prints stored credentials (never run). Parser (T4.53): reads only the --format json fields the live check recorded (sessionID; text part.text; tool_use part.tool and part.state.input; step_finish part.reason, tokens and cost; error error.type and error.message); success needs a step_finish with reason stop (Q-85), so a run that exits 0 without one fails; events name no provider or model, so none is set; resume is `--session <id>`. Git writes (FR-GIT-01): no declared control (ADR-0039); commitChannel finalize-only. Credentials: Switchboard never reads auth.json, mcp-auth.json or .env, never copies or logs OpenCode credentials, never starts login and never scrapes dashboards (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that the CLI documents headless use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with OpenCode's or any backing provider's terms (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-14 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported.
